nom: StriVectin Super-C Dark Circle Brightening Eye Serum

avis.texte: This product is very effective I use at night and under face lotion in the morning. I am seeing results.

avis.titre: Bought for dark circles under eyes
avis.texte: I can still see my dark circles under my eyes. I haven't been using to long. I am waiting to see what happens.

This works very well for me. My dark circles have really improved. However, I am never able to access the product from the pump when it is halfway full. The is no tube connected to the pump. So it just stops delivering the product when you pump it. Considering the cost of this it should have better packaging.

avis.titre: A happy drink for tired eyes!
avis.texte: At 80 years old one can only hope for diminished success on my years of dark circles and thinning skin. But this little Vitamin C serum for eyes is actually helping. It pats on easily and requires only a tiny dab. I use this under the intensive moisturizer for eyes and the two products layer beautifully. I've tried numerous products over the years and have made the StriVectin products a must have for my daily routine.

I splurged a little and bought this tiny eye serum and WOW- nothing has ever gotten rid of my under eye bags like this did. When I ran out, I bought the ordinary caffeine under eye serum and they came back. If you have dark circles and bags this will really help.

avis.titre: Super-C Dark Circle Brightening Eye Serum
avis.texte: Unable to use the product because the pump does not work and product does not come out.
Been using as directed for 30 days. No change in dark circles. Will not waste my money purchasing more.
I haven't notice the puffiness going away but it does brighten my skin. It leaves no residue . I have been using for over a month and will continue to use till finished. Not sure if I will reorder.
This serum works better for me than higher priced brands. I use it at night as creams cause puffiness in under eye area in the morning. I keep coming back to Strivectin products.
Effective! Minimizes puffiness under the eyes as well as dark circles.

I had high hopes for this as my circles have become a big concern. I paid for overnight shipping and my order arrived 3 weeks later… I got a shipping refund but was frustrating. I finally received and after using religiously am and pm for 4 weeks and I have seen not even the smallest effects. It is not even hydrating. I would not recommend.

While I'm not a dark circle person necessarily, as I've gotten older, I am waking up with puffiness. This is perfect for decongesting the eye area and leaving it brighter. It works quickly and I can put makeup on right over it. Best of all, you only little a small amount for both eyes. This is my go-to for my morning routine. Highly recommend!

Bought this on sale because of raving reviews. It truly works. I have sometimes have either other problems dark circle or puffiness. They cancel out both within weeks. The only hard part is that price! Wait for it to go on sale.
Using this product the darkness i had is not visible anymore.
Very nice product. Does not irritate ir get sticky would recommend
I use this product daily. I have hereditary dark circles and nothing seems to eliminate them, but, this product does seem to help some.

This is the only product that has ever worked for my dark circles and they were very dark. I have extremely sensitive skin and it does not irritate my skin or eyes. I tried so many other products before finding this one. Thank you Strivectin!
I have been using this product for a while now. The dark circles under and above my eye are less noticeable. I recommend this product.
My husband and I both love it and have seen results in both reduction in darkness under the eye as well as reduction in puffiness. It is now part of our daily routine!
Like the way it helps our under eye area. It's my bad we do not use it everyday.

avis.titre: Super- C Brightening Eye Serum is a Miracle Worker
avis.texte: Serum works great on dark eye circles. Lightens dark circles under and above eyes and minimizes fine lines. Very effective and noticeable in about 2-3 weeks.
This gave me such a bad eczema breakout. My eyes are so raw now & itchy. I'm miserable. It got so bad I'm hoping my 40 year old eye skin will recover & not have long lasting damage.

Wow! I used this because I was out of my regular eye cream, and with one use, I notifed that my puffy eyebags were visibly lessened. I have dark, puffy eye bags pretty much all the time, with kids and a full time job! When I checked again at midday, the puffiness hadn't returned. The dark circles are still there, but I'm more concerned with puffiness. I can use concealer on the dark circles. It's only been a day, but I will keep using this and see if my dark circles will also diminish with regular use. I've used a lot of Srivectin products and have been satisfied with them. I always get them when there's a sale of course!
I was shocked at the difference this made. I took a picture before I started using it. Then another after three weeks. I used it twice a day. The results were unbelievable.
My favorite eye product. It makes my dark circles disappear. I use this everyday. It's my go to eye product. Love it!!
After just two weeks there was a visible difference. I was very pleased with this product and highly recommend it to anyone with dark circles.

Super-C Dark Circle Brightening Eye Serum is fantastic! Makes a big difference with my Undereye Area dark circles and puffiness. Don't want to go a day without this product. Would highly recommend this product.

I have naturally very oily eyelids, and this definitely cut the oil, but also made my eye area flaky and sucked all the moisture out, making my eyes look dry, older than I am, and saggy. I didn't use the sample long enough to see if it would get rid of any dark circles, but that's honestly the least of my facial concerns. I'd rather have oily lids than deal with dry, saggy skin around my eyes when that wasn't a problem for me before using this.
After several months of using this serum, my under-eye bags are visibly lighter and smoother.
I like the easy pump applicator and I am seeing a reduction in the dark circles appearance after one month of using.
Gets rid of dark circles and lines under eyes. Won't start my day without it anymore!
It definitely brightened under my eyes. I liked it as sort of serum for under my eye cream
My favorite eye cream…my dark eyes have disappeared. I have less creases under my eyes…amazing product. I use this in the day time. I love it!

I was skeptical when i first bought this. However, i have been using this for about 5 months and can say that it definitely works. You have to give it time though. Keep in mind though you need to sleep at least 8 hrs so you actually see a difference. Even on days that i dont sleep that much me eyes dont look as dead. Definitely recommend!!!
Brightens dark circles and smoothes undereye area. Best product I've used and I've tries many.

I usually do not bother with reviews, but I have to give props, this is a great product..

This eye serum is one of my favorite of StriVectin products. My aging eyes have not looked better in a VERY long time. I am very happy with the results.

Great eye Serum, fully recommend. It helps tighten and lighten the area of the eye along with brightening it up. I think it is one of the better products I use and now buy it all the time.

I love this Dark Circle Eye Serum, it is a cream that brightens up your eyes and gives you the results that you are looking for. It is a winner!

avis.titre: Great eye serum for fine lines
avis.texte: I'm 31, and have noticed my under eyes get ring much darker over the last few years and while I did not have severe crows feet, I was starting to notice them forming. I did not see a huge improvement with the darkness under my eyes, however the fine lines that were starting to form have since completely disappeared. I've been using this product for a few months now, every day and night, and I've seen a real enhancement in the under eye skin. It's much tighter, improved elasticity, and stays hydrated. I'll add that I've had the same tube for 6 months and it's not out yet. A little goes a long way. This has become a staple in my skincare routine. I wish it improved my under eye brightness a little more though.
I received a sample with my last order and I have been using twice a day for two weeks...I have seen no change at all. Very disappointed as I love my other Strivectin products.
I've been using this about a month & I do like it. My dark circles are diminished and less puffy during the day. It's a perfect addition to my morning routine. YAY!
I have definitely noticed some improvement. This is a work-in-progress.

I have been using this for a while now and the only benefit I have noticed is that my under eye area is extremely smooth. I haven't seen any improvement in my dark circles after using 3 tubes, and those are my results I have noticed.
Over half way thru my second purchase of this - use morning and night - still not seeing improvement. Expected more from StriVectin. Waste of money for me.
I just purchased this new product because a friend highly recommended I am sure I will be happy with it just like any products from strivectin

She said it was probably superficial enough that the serum repaired my skin and tag fell off! I'm totally using this product repeatedly!

This is by far the best eye cream I have ever used! It blends into my skin quickly. The dark circles under my eyes feel cool and nourished. The results are quick and powerful as the sensitive skin under my eyes tightens and lightens .

I have Native American skin tone and my eyelids have darker variations. This brightened the skin all around my eyes. I was impressed

avis.titre: I would like to purchase this product

I have allergies and the dark circles under my eyes have gotten worse with age (46 years old). After trying lot's of different under eye serums I decided to try this one despite the price tag. But, I applied it differently, only using the serum on one eye for 2 months. And I was finally able to see a BIG difference. Yes, it took 2 months but, the difference is very noticeable. I'm so glad I took this approach because otherwise I would have assumed it wasn't working and I would have been wrong. I highly recommend this product!!
Made a major difference for my dark circles and bags under my eyes. I was given a sample that lasted me about a month and I'm totally investing in it now.

I used this product for over a month and sadly it did nothing to lighten my very dark brown inherited circles, enhanced by a lot of allergies. I have not found anything that works so when I saw this product , I was excited because I love Strivectin products. Still wishing for something that really works. For now I just continue to use concealer. So happy this product works well for other people, because dark circles are annoying!! This product does feel very nice under the eye so that merited 3 stars.

I do believe this tightens and de-puffs but for my inherited, allergy caused, extremely dark brown circles, I have noticed no difference in over a month of use. I really wished it worked. Continue to hope for a miracle worker for these brown circles and will continue to use the tightening eye cream because it tightens reduces puffing just as well as this serum. Sorry!!
I've been using this product for a couple months and I think I'm starting to see a small difference in my dark circles. Will keep using.

I'll leave another review in a couple more weeks.

I got this as a sample at a perfect time. I went through some rough times and ended up in the hospital. My under eyes looked so sunken and dark. After a couple of days of using this my under eyes looked so much better. I will definitely recommend.
Enjoy all of of StriVectin products but this new one is awesome!
This really works! I am almost 80 years old and this product made my undereyes much smoother

With daily use of my new product I am seeing moderate results. I'm hoping with continued use I will see more improvement with the lighting of the dark under-eye circles. The service has been an excellent experience.

This product is so effective and has become a staple in my efforts to improve the texture and color of my skin. I also work with resin. The vitamin C makes a huge difference, lightening the areas around my eyes. Underneath and even my eyelids if redness occurs. This is a product worth investing in if you get those dark circles under your eyes. As with any effective product results will only occur if you follow instructions and are consistent with use.
